## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] The tool is new — I searched the list for its name and its domain
- [ ] It sits in the correct subsection, in alphabetical order
- [ ] The line matches `- **[Name](url)** – Description. \`TAG\``
- [ ] The link is HTTPS, canonical, and opens in a private window
- [ ] No affiliate links, tracking parameters or URL shorteners
- [ ] The description is one factual sentence, no marketing language
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_links.py README.md` passes
- [ ] I have used the tool, or verified that it works today
